title: Nassau birth, Rabbit Foot show, Streckfus riverboat band and New Orleans
summary: Mason describes his birth in Nassau, his father starting him on trumpet, leaving home, touring with the Rabbit Foot show, joining Fate Marable's band with Louis Armstrong, and the 1923 saxophone band in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable
